preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(o1 * o2 <= 10**6 for o1, o2 in test_cases)
preconditions.description: The sum of o1 * o2 over all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(o1 % 2 == 1 and o2 % 2 == 1 for o1, o2 in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Both o1 and o2 are odd positive integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= d <= 1 for d in districts for districts in test_case_data)
preconditions.description: Each district's representative is either 0 (Zero) or 1 (One).

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in [0, 1] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each test case's output is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: all((sum(districts[j:j+o2]) > o2 // 2) for j in range(0, o1 * o2, o2)) or return_value[i] == 0 for i, (o1, o2, districts) in enumerate(test_case_data)
postconditions.description: For each test case, there exists a partitioning of districts into states such that the President can be a One, or the output is 0.
